title: Scope analytics project
goal: The analysis is scoped to what the records can actually answer: the data in reach, the hours it will take, what is deliberately left out, and the smallest version that would still change the decision.

steps.do: List which of the venture's records and connected sources could bear on the question, how far back each goes and how complete it is, and name what is simply not recorded.
Say what the analysis will take in hours and what it needs that the venture does not have, and write the smallest version that would still change the decision.
Write what is in and out of scope, the window the analysis covers and the question it will not answer, and open the handoff with those done criteria.
Raise to the strategy lead whether to run the small version, the full one or neither, with what each would cost and what it could settle.

done_criteria.check: Does the scope name the records the answer will come from and say plainly which part of the question they cannot answer?
